FASTER 
Faster Speeds – Fiber 
carries more data at higher 
speeds. 
WHAT DOES THIS DO FOR ALBUQUERQUE? 
Albuquerque is supporting the expansion of 
fiber internet infrastructure to bring faster, 
more reliable, and affordable internet options 
to residents and businesses. While the City is 
not performing the work, it ensures that all 
projects are properly permitted and meet 
required standards. Private fiber providers are 
responsible for construction, which will take 
place over the next few years in 
neighborhoods, side streets, and major roads 
—primarily within public rights-of-way, 
including sidewalks, curbs, and property lines. 
This explains what to expect during 
construction and how fiber internet will 
improve connectivity across the city. To learn 
more, visit cabq.gov/fiberinternet.

text_excerpts.2:
cabq.gov/fiberinternet 
THE FUTURE OF INTERNET 
IN ALBUQUERQUE 
WHAT TO EXPECT IN YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD 
Neighborhood Notice 
Before construction begins, fiber providers will notify 
residents using flyers, door hangers, yard signs, postcards, or 
street signs. View approved permits at: 
www.cabq.gov/constructionreport 
Markings 
 Temporary paint and flags may be placed by utility owners 
to mark their underground utilities. Please do not remove 
these markings—they prevent accidental damage. 
Construction Process 
Contractors will bring trucks and equipment to work on the 
fiber installation. 
Construction hours: Mon-Sat, 7am-4pm 
Open holes with safety fences may be present in public 
rights-of-way. 
Construction timelines vary by location. 
Post-Installation 
Legally, the companies must restore construction areas to its 
their original condition. 
Homes and businesses may have the option to connect to 
fiber internet services. 
Why Is this happening? 
The City of Albuquerque has 
permitted fiber internet providers to 
install new infrastructure to expand 
faster, more reliable, and affordable 
internet options for residents and 
businesses. 
What is involved? 
Fiber companies use contractors and 
subcontractors to install fiber 
underground and on utility poles. Most 
work occurs in public rights-of-way, 
including:
 Property lines between houses
 Areas near sidewalks, streets, and 
curbs 
Why fiber internet? 
Faster speeds 
Fiber carries more data at higher 
speeds. 
More reliable connection 
Less interference and fewer 
outages. 
Future-proof technology 
Supports new advancements 
without costly upgrades. 
FOR CONCERNS ABOUT CONSTRUCTION, CONTACT 
FIBER COMPANIES DIRECTLY: 
Ezee Fiber – 505-539-4848 
Gigapower – 505-420-5195 
Vexus Fiber – 844-512-5022
